description: This file defines the 'EmailsViewCompose' class, which extends 'ViewEdit'. It is responsible for rendering the compose email view in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for initializing the view, configuring the editor, and setting up various template variables related to email composition.

classes.name: EmailsViewCompose
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the email compose view, managing initialization, metadata setup, and editor configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets default options for the compose view and defines its type.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the compose view by assigning necessary variables to the template, loading metadata, and setting up the TinyMCE editor.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Returns an instance of ComposeView which manages the email compose editor.

methods.name: getSignatures
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve user email signatures and prepend them to the email body.

methods.name: setupTinyMCEConfig
methods.description: Configures the TinyMCE rich text editor by loading its configuration and passing it to the template.
